arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && cat > src/replay_api.c <<'EOF'
/* Offline replay ABI glue.
 *
 * The whole collector lives in src/star4_switch.c; the wire codec lives in
 * src/roce_packet.c. This translation unit only documents the split so the
 * published Makefile keeps compiling the three modules together.
 */
typedef int epic_replay_api_translation_unit_t;
EOF
cat > Makefile <<'EOF'
CC = gcc
BUILD ?= build
CFLAGS = -std=c11 -O2 -fPIC -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-parameter
SOURCES = src/replay_api.c src/star4_switch.c src/roce_packet.c
.PHONY: all clean
all: $(BUILD)/libepic.so
$(BUILD)/libepic.so: $(SOURCES) include/epic_clean.h include/offline_api.h include/offline_port.h
	mkdir -p $(BUILD)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -Iinclude -shared $(SOURCES) -o $@
clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD)
EOF
cat include/offline_port.h; make -s BUILD=/tmp/b2 -j2 2>&1 | head -40 && echo BUILD_OK
